summary: Frontend testing for OM mantra chant sound and guided voice controls - verified OM has chant-capable audio (generated OM tone via Web Audio API), mantra modal shows chanting timer with sound, guided overlays have single reliable voice control (Play Voice Guidance), no duplicate Voice Options controls, and no 'Tap to Retry Voice' text.

om_mantra_audio.details: OM mantra uses generated OM tone via Web Audio API (playOmTone function at 136.1 Hz)
om_mantra_audio.toast_confirmation: Shows 'OM chant resonance playing' toast when started
om_mantra_audio.meditation_sound_toggle: Shows 'ON - Bells & Om' toggle in modal

mantra_modal_audio_player.volume_control: Volume slider and mute button present
mantra_modal_audio_player.no_js_errors: No audio-related JS errors when playing

guided_overlay_single_voice_control.button_text: Shows 'Play Voice Guidance' or 'Restart Voice Guidance'

tap_to_retry_removal.details: No 'Tap to Retry Voice' text found in codebase or rendered UI

context_for_next_testing_agent: OM mantra now uses generated OM tone via Web Audio API (playOmTone at 136.1 Hz) with fallback URL. Guided overlays have single 'Play Voice Guidance' button with Voice/Speed override dropdowns. All duplicate Voice Options controls and 'Tap to Retry Voice' text have been removed from codebase. Console 401 errors are expected for unauthenticated users (favorites API). Console warning about OM audio URL is expected since OM uses generated sound, not external URL.
